en: The image shows a vintage postcard depicting a large, ornate building with a tower and several rows of windows. The style is typical of late 19th or early 20th-century European institutional architecture. The text on the postcard is in German and identifies the building as an orphanage (Städtisches Waisenhaus) associated with the Gisela-Valerie and Karl Bergmann foundations, located on Stiftingthalstrasse in Graz.
